scope: Resolve the HATCH/MPOLYGON active-gradient target-version boundary and prevent R2004+ gradient groups from being emitted to older DXF targets.

observed: Autodesk's AutoCAD 2004 API history marks AcGradientObject, gradient hatch properties, and the AddHatch object-type change as new in 2004.
Autodesk's February 2004 AutoCAD 2005 DXF Reference documents HATCH gradient control groups 450-470 and the required companion fields.
The repository's DRW::Version map identifies AC1018 as AutoCAD 2004/2005/2006 and AC1015 as AutoCAD 2000/2000i/2002.
primaryResearch.evidenceBoundary: This supports a conservative AC1018 minimum-qualified output profile. It does not prove every R2004+ consumer has identical gradient rendering, nor does it resolve the meanings of groups 431/432/433 or establish that an older version could not preserve a gradient through another documented mechanism.

implementation.targetPolicy: Shared HATCH/MPOLYGON payload validation rejects an active gradient when target version is below AC1018, before entity bytes are published.
implementation.roundTripPolicy: No automatic flattening or silent loss is introduced; callers may choose a separate explicit-loss policy in future work.
unresolved: Cross-application gradient rendering and consumer acceptance.
